content.markdown:
**V1.6.10** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on December 23rd, 2022.

## V1.6.10

- Feature - [#12768](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/12768) Seasonal skins for animals

- Rework - [#14617](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14617) Lock derailing behind vehicle damage setting
- Fix - Lua scripts memory leak crash
- Fix - Ocean thread memory leak
- Fix - Beginner Island missing seasonal assets
- Fix - Added default storage zone to meier outpost garage
- Fix - [#14925](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14925) Fix typo in kahrstrom gas station
- Fix - [#15024](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15024) Only tick world raycasting vehicle components if scene is ticking
- Fix - [#15015](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15015) Fix building fires not failing to spawn if their tile is not in range and the player is near world origin
- Fix - [#15503](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15503) Removed rps nodes from small and mid steam train wheels
- Fix - [#15764](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15764) Unopenable door, and Invisible door hitbox in Aljon Hospital
- Fix - [#15791](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15791) Arctic train signals missing
- Fix - [#14620](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14620) Reserved voxels on x3 train wheels
- Fix - [#14673](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14673) Fixed missing physics voxels on large train wheels
- Fix - [#14623](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14623) [#15228](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15228) [#14897](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14897) [#15063](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15063) Fixed small train wheels force resolution issues
- Fix - [#14662](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14662) Derailed train wheels damping
- Rework - [#14953](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14953) Removed dysfunctional vehicle editor resource usage hints
- Fix - [#15226](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15226) Fix negative uranium fuel levels
- Balance - [#15226](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15226) Reverted balance change to rod consumption rate (now 100x longer)
- Fix - [#15000](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15000) Reload scripts now reloads from the autosave directory
- Fix - Mesh height on large steam drive piston
- Fix - [#15414](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15414) Check NPC damage setting before applying injuries in default missions
- Fix - [#15598](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15598) Train Bridges Causing Random Explosions on Trains
- Fix - [#15833](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15833) Trainline issue near Serpentine Trainyard
- Fix - Updated main menu tile render priority for arid and seasonal events

## Source

- [Steam Community News](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/573090/view/3629369950917517037?l=english)
